info.name: Delivery Backend API - By Role
info.description:
Complete API collection organized by user role.

UPDATED (Dec 1, 2025 - v2):

- OTP verification flow for delivery status
    
- Delivery Outcomes: PARTIAL_DELIVERY, EXCHANGE, PAID_RETURN, RETURNED
    
- Rescheduled Deliveries: DELIVERY_RESCHEDULED (separate endpoint)
    
- Return Parcel Tracking: Creates RTN-xxx parcel with original_parcel_id link
    
- Hub Manager actions: Mark Return to Merchant, Prepare for Redelivery
    
- Added: GET /pickup-requests/rider/my-pickups (legacy)
    
- Added: GET /riders/parcels/my-deliveries (legacy)
    
- Added: POST /delivery-verifications/:id/request-otp

Updates an existing payout method for a rider. Supports partial updates — only include the fields you want to change. The behavior depends on the method type (bank account, bKash, or Nagad).

---

## Path Parameters

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | UUID of the payout method to update |

---

## Request Body Options

### Option 1: Bank Account (Full Update)

Update all fields of a bank account payout method.

``` bash
{
  "method_type": "BANK_ACCOUNT",
  "bank_name": "BRAC Bank",
  "branch_name": "Gulshan Branch",
  "account_holder_name": "Rakib Hasan",
  "account_number": "123456789012",
  "routing_number": "060261726"
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `method_type` | string | Must be `BANK_ACCOUNT` |
| `bank_name` | string | Name of the bank |
| `branch_name` | string | Branch name |
| `account_holder_name` | string | Full name of the account holder |
| `account_number` | string | Bank account number |
| `routing_number` | string | Bank routing number |

---

### Option 2: Bank Account (Using Alias Keys)

Alternative field names accepted for bank account updates.

``` json
{
  "account_name": "Rakib Hasan",
  "account_no": "123456789012"
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `account_name` | string | Alias for `account_holder_name` |
| `account_no` | string | Alias for `account_number` |

---

### Option 3: Bank Account (Partial Update)

Update only specific bank account fields.

``` json
{
  "bank_name": "Dutch-Bangla Bank",
  "branch_name": "Uttara Branch"
}

 ```

---

### Option 4: bKash (Full Update)

Update all fields of a bKash payout method.

``` json
{
  "method_type": "BKASH",
  "bkash_number": "01712345678",
  "bkash_account_holder_name": "Rakib Hasan",
  "bkash_account_type": "PERSONAL"
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `method_type` | string | Must be `BKASH` |
| `bkash_number` | string | bKash mobile number |
| `bkash_account_holder_name` | string | Full name of the bKash account holder |
| `bkash_account_type` | string | Account type: `PERSONAL` or `MERCHANT` |

---

### Option 5: bKash (Partial Update)

Update only specific bKash fields.

``` json
{
  "bkash_number": "01812345678"
}

 ```

---

### Option 6: Nagad (Full Update)

Update all fields of a Nagad payout method.

``` json
{
  "method_type": "NAGAD",
  "nagad_number": "01912345678",
  "nagad_account_holder_name": "Rakib Hasan",
  "nagad_account_type": "PERSONAL"
}

 ```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `method_type` | string | Must be `NAGAD` |
| `nagad_number` | string | Nagad mobile number |
| `nagad_account_holder_name` | string | Full name of the Nagad account holder |
| `nagad_account_type` | string | Account type: `PERSONAL` or `MERCHANT` |

---

{

}
